name: Dumbbell Lying Single-Arm Reverse Fly
steps: Lie face down on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in one hand, bracing the bench with your free hand.
Let the weighted arm hang straight below your shoulder with a slight bend in your elbow.
Sweep the dumbbell out to the side to shoulder height, then lower it smoothly under control.
Complete the working arm, then switch sides and repeat.
tips: Keep both sides of your chest flat against the bench without rotating open.
Use a controlled tempo and keep your working shoulder away from your ear.
